sources.title: feat(export): export a conversation as PDF
sources.text:
Pull request #710: feat(export): export a conversation as PDF
Merged: 2026-08-03T10:00:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- 1f2e3d4 feat(export): export a conversation as PDF (#710)

Closes #702.

Adds **Export as PDF** to the conversation menu. The PDF keeps headings, code blocks and Frame names.

Available on macOS and Windows. Linux is not supported yet: the bundled font renderer crashes on some system fonts, tracked in #712. The menu item is hidden on Linux.

- 2a3b4c5 fix(history): keep the scroll position when a new message arrives (#715)
